description: Figure 12 is a line plot illustrating the Pass@8 accuracy on the merged AIME 2024 and AMC datasets as a function of generation temperature, which ranges from 0.1 to 1.0 on the x-axis. The y-axis represents Accuracy (Pass@8), scaled from 62.5 to 80.0. Four methods are compared: On-policy RL (orange line with diamond markers), LUFFY (red line with star markers), SFT (blue line with triangle markers), and a fourth method represented by a teal line with inverted triangle markers. The On-policy RL line starts at approximately 63.0 at temperature 0.1, rises to a peak near 72.5 at temperature 0.7, then declines slightly to about 73.0 at 1.0. The LUFFY line begins at roughly 76.0, fluctuates slightly around 76.5–77.5, peaks at approximately 78.5 at temperature 0.8, and ends near 78.0 at 1.0. The SFT line starts at about 76.0, dips to 75.0 at 0.3, rises to 76.5 at 0.6, then drops to 74.0 at 0.8 before recovering to 75.5 at 1.0. The teal line begins at 76.0, dips to 74.0 at 0.3, rises to 76.5 at 0.6, then drops to 72.5 at 0.8 before rising to 75.0 at 1.0. All lines exhibit some fluctuation, but LUFFY and On-policy RL generally maintain higher and more stable performance across temperatures compared to SFT and the teal method, particularly at higher temperatures.
